Reviewed the router and dispatch additions. The historical R4a composition had two tools. The new native search is optional in the isolated composition and goes through current grant and emission admission. The compiled release guard stays installed.

Checked the approval target and global review facts. The new label explains the existing outside-Project scope. The selection and read-only approval authority still bind the same Project identities and fingerprints.

Traced the ordinary agent work-discovery registrations and the separate optional outside client registration. Existing agent search still uses its native and file-backed owners. The isolated outside client search omits file-backed work until custody is established.

The response reports incomplete file and host coverage. Focused isolated checks were performed and release exposure remains guarded.
